comparisons.peer_topic: Commissions and Fees and GM Credit Card Transition
comparisons.peer_summary: Commissions and fees were $4.09 billion in 2024, an 8% increase from 2023, driven by higher commissions and fees in Equities due to higher market volumes and increased transaction fees, partially offset by a loss related to the planned transition of the GM credit card program.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan (JPM) and Goldman Sachs (GS) report an increase in commissions and fees driven by higher market volumes. JPM attributes higher volume directly to increased brokerage commissions and custody fees across its CIB and AWM segments. Similarly, GS reports that its commissions and fees increased 8% primarily due to higher market volumes in Equities, which resulted in higher transaction fees. While JPM also cites specific fee types (custody, annuity sales) and segments (CCB), GS isolates the volume driver to Equities and notes an offsetting loss from a credit card transition, whereas JPM does not mention such offsets in this specific fee category.

sentences.text: Commissions and other fees increased, predominantly due to higher brokerage commissions and fees on higher volume, and higher custody fees, in both CIB and AWM, as well as higher annuity sales commissions in CCB.

Commissions and fees in the consolidated statements of earnings were $4.09 billion for 2024, 8% higher than 2023, due to higher commissions and fees in Equities, reflecting generally higher market volumes and increased transaction fees, partially offset by a loss related to the planned transition of the GM credit card program to another issuer.

peer_results.rationale: Candidates ms_2024_7_D030 and ms_2024_7_D041 are structural definitions explaining what is included in 'Equity and Fixed Income Net Revenues' and 'Transactional' categories respectively. They do not provide factual disclosures regarding the drivers, volume, or changes in commissions and fees for the period, making them insufficient for comparing the specific business drivers (like volume or fee types) reported by JPM.
